mapper.update: UPDATE xsy_scale_device SET status = 'ACTIVE', credential_hash = #{credentialHash}, credential_expires_at = #{credentialExpiresAt}, protocol_type = #{protocolType}, agent_version = #{agentVersion}, pairing_code_hash = NULL, pairing_expires_at = NULL, last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'PENDING_ACTIVATION' AND pairing_code_hash = #{pairingCodeHash} AND pairing_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND pairing_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE xsy_scale_device SET last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, agent_version = #{agentVersion}, protocol_type = #{protocolType}, scale_connected = #{scaleConnected}, printer_connected = #{printerConnected}, queue_depth = #{queueDepth}, last_reading_at = COALESCE(#{lastReadingAt}, last_reading_at), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE xsy_scale_device SET status = 'REVOKED', credential_hash = NULL, credential_expires_at = NULL, pairing_code_hash = NULL, pairing_expires_at = NULL, revoked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, revoked_by = #{operator}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND status <> 'REVOKED'
